name: How long does a typical shower or tub upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical shower or tub upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most shower or tub upgrade projects take between 3 to 7 days, depending on the complexity and extent of the work. This includes demolition, plumbing adjustments, new fixture installation, tiling, and finishing. Larger projects involving significant layout changes or custom work may take longer. We'll provide a timeline during our project planning.
